name: Ooka Sushi & Hibachi Steak House, Willow Grove
hours: Lunch and dinner daily. Sunday is dinner menu only.
description: Ooka in Willow Grove is a BYOB sushi and hibachi steak house on Easton Road, with lunch and dinner seven days a week.
tagline: Sushi and hibachi, BYOB, Easton Road

hero.eyebrow: Willow Grove, PA | Sushi and hibachi
hero.headline: Sushi bar on one side, hibachi fire on the other
hero.sub: Ooka's Willow Grove steak house serves sushi and hibachi for lunch and dinner seven days a week, and it is BYOB.

offerings.heading: Two ways to <mark>eat here.</mark>
items: Sushi and sashimi from the bar, rolls built to share
Hibachi steak, chicken, shrimp, and scallops cooked at the table
Lunch specials on weekdays and a Sunday dinner menu

story.heading: The hibachi room and the sushi bar
paragraphs: Ooka's Willow Grove location on Easton Road runs two rooms: a sushi bar with the chef in view, and a hibachi room where dinner is cooked at the table.
Bring your own bottle. Lunch runs weekdays and Saturday, dinner every night.

experience.heading: Planning dinner
items: Call ahead for a hibachi table on weekend nights.
Bring wine or sake; the restaurant is BYOB.
Lunch specials are the fast way in on a weekday.

feature.heading: Hibachi for the table
feature.text: Steak, chicken, shrimp, and scallops on the flat-top grill, with fried rice and vegetables, cooked in front of the group.

closing.heading: Sushi and hibachi, BYOB, seven days a week
